title: Heavy Electric Cars Have a Problem Nobody Talks About #shorts

scenes.text: This electric pickup weighs over nine thousand pounds. Its battery alone weighs as much as a Honda Civic.
That weight protects the people inside. But what about the other car in the crash?
Economists found that being hit by a vehicle a thousand pounds heavier raises your risk of dying by forty seven percent.
In twenty twenty five, a safety institute found extra weight barely helps its own driver, but endangers everyone else.
To be fair, big gas pickups and SUVs are just as heavy.
So should heavier cars pay more to register? Tell me below. Follow EV Drive.
